description: Windows disk imaging and backup utility for creating and restoring complete system and disk images.

script: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw ('O&O DiskImage Premium MSI was not found: ' + $msi) }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "O&O DiskImage Premium installation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw ('O&O DiskImage Premium MSI was not found: ' + $msi) }
if ($null -eq $record) { throw 'Could not read ProductCode from the retained MSI.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010, 1605)) { throw "O&O DiskImage Premium uninstallation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }

notes: Nonportable: installs the OODiskImagePremiumService Windows service through O&O's official MSI package. Installation and removal require administrator approval; a restart may be requested. Scoop retains the original MSI in its version directory so its ProductCode remains available for native Windows Installer removal.
